7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Case Number: UP-2016-01 (Live Entertainment), UP-2016-02 (24 Hour Operation), sssssssssss UP-2016-03 (Alcohol), MUP-2016-03 (Outdoor Storage), MUP-2016-14 s (Outdoor Dinning) Location: 1001 N. Todd Avenue
APN: 8617-001-020
Applicant: Lagunitas Brewery Company
Use Permits for Live Entertainment, 24 hour operation, alcohol sale for on-site and off-site consumption, and Minor Use Permits Outdoor Storage and Outdoor Dining. The subject site is located within the West End Industrial (DWL) zone. The environmental impacts of this project were previously reviewed in conjunction with an Environmental Impact Report (SCH# 2013121096) prepared for Xebec Realty Partners, which was adopted by the Azusa Planning Commission (by Resolution No. 2014-11) on July 30, 2014. This Application introduces no new significant environmental impacts.
